# Asteroid Drift

Neon-noir space survival. Fly, shoot, shatter, and survive the endless asteroid fields!

## How to Play
- **W / S**: Pitch up / down
- **A / D**: Yaw left / right
- **Space**: Thrust forward
- **Shift**: Brake / Reverse thrust
- **Shoot** asteroids to trigger cascading breakups!
- Collect **Energy Cores** for temporary speed boosts and invincibility frames.
- Survive as many waves as possible—your high score is saved locally!
